billions in energy storage annually, creating a permanent strategic vulnerability
in the nation's clean energy transition. Lithium-Ion
Metric Lithium-Ion (LIB) Sodium-Ion (SIB) India's Gain
Raw Material Rare / Imported Abundant / Domestic Energy Sovereignty
Precursor Cost $14L–$80L / tonne $20K–$25K / tonne Cost-Effective EVs
Current Collector Copper (Anode) Aluminium (Both) Reduced System Weight
Safety Profile High Thermal Risk Enhanced Stability Tropical Climate Ready
Supply Chain Highly Concentrated Diversified / Local Resilience to Shocks
SIB technology reduces cell-level costs by an estimated 20–30% relative to LFP chemistries, with a path to 100X disruption through PET upcycling. Princya Polin S
